title: Medtrum : PasswordReset doesn't work
body:
Latest _dev_ (but also on _master_ 3321), I force close AAPS, create a _PasswordReset_ file in aaps/extra, I start AAPS, I start config wizard, enter my pump base serial, it says wrong password. Same result on dev and Master 

On _dev_ the file stays, on _master_ the file gets deleted.

comments.body: it should work. It's in lowercase

this makes it uppercase which is more expectable
https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/0534153281668271e5b70d506e0f52d125f9e5b1

Yes, lowercase works.

The serial is written in upper case on the pump base, so your new mod will "work" better.

Tnx 👍🏻
